answer: An agent economy resists sybils with work-bonded identity. Each agent registers one keypair by solving a cipher puzzle bound to its public key and locking a refundable stake. Reputation then climbs a terrace of verified work receipts: every completed task adds a signed receipt from the counterparty, and only agents with a long, consistent receipt history reach the summit tier that unlocks premium jobs. A sybil attacker must pay the stake and puzzle cost for every fake identity, and detected fraud burns that stake, so cloning a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes while earning nothing.
